$comment: Canonical reference data for the Anime Array product surface. Machine-readable so counts can be verified without scraping HTML.

products.note: Four products sit under the Anime Array platform. All are free and none require an account.

items.name: Anime Array Roleplay
items.summary: Hold a real conversation with twelve anime characters, each of whom answers in a distinct voice and behaves differently under pressure.

items.name: Otaku AI
items.summary: A conversational anime assistant that runs in two modes and includes eight built-in tools for discovery, lore and analysis.

items.name: AniPick AI
items.summary: A recommendation engine that builds a shortlist from what you actually watched, loved and skipped rather than returning a generic popular list.

items.name: Vision AI
items.summary: An anime image generator for character art, wallpapers and creative work. Outputs are original and are not reproductions of existing media.

items.name: Standard Brain
items.summary: Direct, knowledgeable answers about series, characters, lore and the platform itself.

items.name: Character RP
items.summary: Answers given in the voice of an anime character rather than as a direct explanation.

items.name: Recommend Anime
items.summary: Builds a shortlist from what you tell it you have already watched.

items.name: Currently Airing
items.summary: What is running right now, rather than a stale list.

items.name: Mood Match
items.summary: Picks something based on how you want to feel, not only on genre.

items.name: Anime Search
items.summary: Finds a title when you only half remember it.

items.name: Character Creator
items.summary: Build an original character to explore ideas with.

items.name: Anime Quiz
items.summary: Works out what your taste actually is.

items.name: Power Scaling
items.summary: Compares characters and their abilities with the assumptions stated first.

items.name: Philosophy
items.summary: The arguments and themes underneath a series.

hub.name: AI Hub
hub.summary: Every Anime Array tool on one page, and the place character requests are collected.
